adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a design concern in the diff. The change to `createEvent(event: CalendarEvent, credentialId: number)` in Calendar.d.ts does require providers to search through the destinationCalendar array using credentialId (as seen in GoogleCalendarService.ts line 145-147: `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)`). Multiple implementers (Google, Lark, Office365) use first-item semantics with `[mainHostDestinationCalendar]` destructuring. This is a valid architectural concern about the API design - passing the selected destination directly would be cleaner than passing credentialId and having each provider search. However, this is a design/architecture suggestion rather than a bug - the code works correctly as implemented.
